payload.content: Payntra API convention: server endpoints wrap top-level resources in a singular-named envelope ({templates:[...]}, {template:{...}}, {items:[...]}, {item:{...}}). Client apiFetch calls declare the wrapper shape and unwrap with .then((r) => r.x); consumers see the inner type, not the envelope. Exceptions are auth/health endpoints that return {ok:true} or {ok,db}. Discriminated-union service results (kind:'ok'|'forbidden'|'not_found') must be narrowed in route handlers before field access, and any variant the service never produces should be removed from the union type to keep TS happy.
